title: Lemma 5.4: periodic Lipschitz retraction onto the n-skeleton
statement: Lemma 5.4 (periodic retraction onto the n-skeleton). Let m, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≥ 1, n := m + 1, d := n + ℓ, C := [0,1]^d, q := (1/2,…,1/2). There is c = c(m,ℓ) ∈ [0,∞) such that for every a ∈ ℝ^d with Σ_i(a_i − 1/2)² < 1/16 (i.e. a ∈ B_{1/4}(q)), writing La := L_{ℓ−1}(a) := {y ∈ ℝ^d : there is a set J of m + 2 coordinate indices with y_i − a_i ∈ ℤ for all i ∈ J}, there is a map ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d such that (i) ψ(x) ∈ L_n := ⋃_F latticeFace 1 F (the union of the closed n-faces of the unit cubical lattice, F ∈ LatticeFaceIndex (m+1) (m+1+ℓ)) for every x ∉ La; (ii) for every z ∈ ℤ^d and every x ∉ La with z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i, also z_i ≤ ψ(x)_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i; (iii) for every σ with 0 < σ ≤ 1/4, ψ is Lipschitz with constant c/σ on {x : dist(x, La) ≥ σ}.
lean_statement: ∀ m ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∃ c : ℝ≥0, ∀ a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), ∑ i, (a i - 1 / 2) ^ 2 < 1 / 16 → ∀ La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∃ ψ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x, x ∉ La → ψ x ∈ ⋃ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1 + ℓ), latticeFace 1 F) ∧ (∀ (z : Fin (m + 1 + ℓ) → ℤ) (x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), x ∉ La → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ ψ x i ∧ ψ x i ≤ z i + 1) ∧ ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ 1 / 4 → LipschitzOnWith (c / Real.toNNReal σ) ψ {x | σ ≤ infDist x La}
